newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba-economic growth no danger for price stability.
newsitem.headline: Buba-economic growth no danger for price stability.

text.p: Relatively strong growth in the German economy does not signal danger for price stability in Germany, the Bundesbank said on Tuesday

"Germany has conclusively reached the goal of price stability. For the Bundesbank it is now a question of securing this success long-term," the German central bank said in its monthly report for December.

The Bundesbank said that the rise in prices in November was "satisfactory" and that consumer prices rose only 1.4 percent in November from the previous year, even though a drastic rise in oil prices to the end of October had made imports dearer.
Higher import costs would be balanced out by the trend of lower unit labour costs, the Bundesbank said.
